# Review: plan:nav-login-loop

**Head:** d65ea0930e1cf5c80dccc66f1edb7da73673c329. **Parent:**574d871cab23673260ba3929b4e1c9514e060870.
**Reviewer:**pij-unaware-quokka. **Request:**01a1ce6d-dcd2-7163-86db-3e6e7ff64afe.

## Verdict: PASS-WITH-NOTES

No changed-source blocker found. The real OAuth-on proxy regression fails on the exact parent and passes at this head; an independently exercised exact-head OAuth-on production artifact serves signed-out `/login` without a loop, serves only the intended added static namespaces, and still redirects protected pages/returns API401.

Notes: real GitHub provider/callback login was not exercised; the positive authenticated path uses a locally minted Auth.js JWT. The complete FFT log passes its configured gates but lacks an embedded exact-SHA/overall-exit receipt. The prepared OAuth artifact includes cloned generated icons; this is not B6's permanent fresh-cache setup fix.

## Source and public boundary

Three-file delta: proxy.ts, auth/domain.md, one106-line six-case test. `proxy.ts:157–164` matches exact `/login`, slash-delimited `/icons/` and `/fonts/`, and exact `/apple-touch-icon.png`, `/icon-192.png`, `/icon-512.png`. It does not admit `/login/elsewhere`, `/iconsx`, `/fontsx`, protected workspace routes or APIs. No protected route beneath the added static namespaces or rewrite into protected content was found.

The bootstrap stage still runs first (`:205–223`); these paths are not added to AUTH_BYPASS_ROUTES. Existing missing-cookie page/popup behavior is unchanged. The new helper addresses only the subsequent GitHub-session layer. Existing Auth.js `/api/auth/*`, Next static bundles and manifest matcher exclusions remain unchanged.

Root IconThemeProvider's manifest fetch, root touch-icon metadata and webmanifest PNG references are covered. Fonts serve existing terminal styling and are broader than login currently requires, but are public static assets, not an exposure of protected content. Auth domain contract/history updated. No new domain/component relationship requiring C4 change identified.

LoginBoundaryReview independently traced the allowlist, actual asset consumers, bootstrap ordering, real Auth.js handler/callback integration and test isolation; no findings. The dynamic test imports intentionally exercise environment-dependent module initialization, not an incidental lazy-import pattern.

## Failing-before / passing-after

Focused command:
`nice -n 19 pnpm exec vitest run test/unit/web/proxy-login-redirect.test.ts`

- **Exact parent574:** unchanged six-case regression copied only to owned disposable snapshot `/tmp/review-login-parent-574`; **2 expected failures /4 passes**. Both `/login` and icon manifest returned Location `http://localhost:3000/login` instead of null. The four negative boundary cases still passed.2.07s,16:30:52.
- **d65:** all **6 pass**,2.59s,16:28:51.
- Existing `proxy.test.ts`51 + `auth.test.ts`7: **58 pass**,4.25s,16:30:52.
- Total target verification: **64 tests /3 files** in two targeted invocations. Full outputs read, no reviewer full run.

The temporary regression fixture and entire owned parent snapshot were removed. No product file was edited, weakened, skipped or suppressed. Observed result record: `/tmp/reviewer-login-d65-before-after.json`.

## Independent exact-head OAuth-on browser proof

Normal FFT artifact `kedH4cbvJpb1SCptF6ZvW` was retained at chainglass-ssr-dashboard-login but had DISABLE_AUTH=true; it was explicitly NOT substituted for OAuth-on proof. Earlier author login-proof/realauth artifacts used0cc+samepatch and their build had been overwritten; those were also not credited as exact-d65 runtime proof.

Author supplied a separate preserved artifact:
- Worktree `/Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass-ssr-dashboard-login-oauth`; initial HEAD independently d65, no tracked/staged diff.
- BUILD_ID **0V9K9-a2ujMfIPd8nLZRq**, independently read.
- Author build command: `DISABLE_AUTH=false DISABLE_GITHUB_OAUTH=false nice -n19 pnpm exec next build`; `/tmp/ssr-probe/build-login-oauth-d65.log` all264 lines read. Successful compile/static-generation; three whole-project tracing warnings and Node color warnings, no compile failure. Type validation skipped by Next, so this is not substituted for the separate nine-config FFT gate.
- Dependencies installed offline/frozen by author; packages/dist and CLI/dist reused from d65 FFT artifact; generated public/icons cloned into this prepared artifact. No reviewer build/copy.

Reviewer served it on owned localhost3194 with BOTH disable flags false, nice19. Clean isolated Chromium initially had no cookies. `/login` first displayed the bootstrap-code popup; entering the artifact's existing code unlocked the real sign-in screen. No session cookie was installed until after all signed-out negative checks; `/api/auth/session` returned200/null.

| Request with valid bootstrap, no GitHub session | Observed |
|---|---|
| `/login` |200 HTML; actual GitHub sign-in button, no loop |
| `/icons/material-icon-theme/manifest.json` |200 application/json |
| Three exact PNG exceptions |Each200 image/png |
| Fira Code and Ubuntu Mono real woff2 paths |Each200 font/woff2 |
| `/workspaces`, `/workspaces/chainglass` |Each307 Location `/login` |
| `/login/elsewhere`, `/iconsx`, `/fontsx` |Each307 Location `/login` |
| `/api/workspaces`, `/api/terminal/token` |Each401 application/json |
| `/api/auth/session` |200, null |

Then a locally minted valid Auth.js JWT produced200 session JSON containing Review fixture and200 workspace with actual sidebar, main and Chainglass heading. After removing that cookie, native browser navigation to `/workspaces` ended at `/login` with the sign-in button. This proves enabled-session composition, not native GitHub OAuth approval/callback or allowlist-login flow.

Screenshots inspected:
- `/tmp/reviewer-login-d65-signed-out.png`
- `/tmp/reviewer-login-d65-signed-session.png`

Receipt `/tmp/reviewer-login-d65-oauth-proof.json` records exact head/build, status/MIME/boundaries and final browser diagnostic output. Text-decoded body lengths in that JSON are explicitly not on-wire byte counts.

No console error or JS pageerror observed. **15 requestfailed ERR_ABORTED** cancellations (RSC/prefetch/actions during route changes) remain explicitly disclosed; not claimed as “no diagnostic entries.” Actual affected pages compiled and loaded, so this proof also covers the touched proxy/root composition at the runtime boundary.

## Terminal evidence scope

All four supplied term-login-{localhost,lan}-{terminal,overlay}.json receipts and scripts were reviewed: bootstrap verification, xterm mount, streamed prompt, typed echo, resize and terminal/token API200s on both hosts. Window creation/selection is proven only in overlay mode; the dedicated page has no window strip. Those sidecar sessions report user=debug and the LAN run reinjects the bootstrap cookie without Secure. They are the older0cc+samepatch composition, NOT exact-d65 compiled terminal proof or native LAN/OAuth login.

This change does not modify terminal startup, WebSocket credentials, CLI discovery or remote-view implementation. The exact OAuth-on negative terminal-token HTTP401 and authenticated workspace composition were exercised above. Header-spoofable localhost trust remains the separately assigned guard request9c8406b3e; this verdict does not claim d65 addresses that parent flaw.

## Complete required gate

LoginGateReview read all **4303 lines** of `/tmp/ssr-probe/fft-login.log` raw through EOF. **352156 bytes**, SHA256 **0b7f9ae6c8186ab3b47e1c7c8cfe4a7357899bf4d0deeea85810737acfd8c0fe**.
- Lint/format1809 files each; no changes/diagnostics.
- Build7/7 successful,5 cached; web+CLI executed,25.095s. Dependency cache replay is not fresh compilation.
- All9 canonical tsconfigs, including harness and test; no TypeScript diagnostics.
-554 passed /7 skipped files;7315 passed /60 skipped tests;7375 total. The six new proxy cases appear and pass.574's previously audited7309+6=7315.
- Vitest16:12:32,427.98s, approximately16:19:40; logmtime16:19:43.
- Audit3 low16 moderate; no high/critical at configured threshold.
- No failed gate/unhandled worker/timeout failure summary. Color/config/auth/Reactact warnings,3 tracing warnings,8 CJSimport.meta warnings, nonfatal missing-host watcher diagnostics and expected-negative logs remain. Not warning-free or skip-free.

**Provenance ceiling:** FFT ran before16:21:51 commit and names original author worktree; it contains no SHA/BUILD_ID/overall rc/start-load wrapper. Current detached head/retained normal build corroborate author delivery; historical final-tree and launch binding remain author statements. The separate exact-head OAuth-on artifact was source-bound and exercised independently, not silently equated with the normal-env FFT build. No reviewer build or full gate rerun.

## Teardown and next

Owned browser and Next3194 stopped; no sidecar or tmux session was created. Private700TMPDIR existed before launch; prior explicit-L resolution named only `/private/tmp/review-login-d65-tmux/...`, not the machine default. No kill-server/default cleanup, Jordan3000/dev operation or main product edit. Author notified that reviewer hold on both login artifacts is released; prime may retain them.

Next: review high-priority localhost-guard9c8406b3e using its retained artifact; separately land the queued ctx-rank/nav-canon corrections. No additional login fix is requested by this review. A sealed FFT receipt (HEAD/tree/env-mode/BUILD_ID/exit) would remove the repeated historical-binding inference in future deliveries.
